attribution_limitations: Discussion states a CD4+ nadir of 0.16×10^(9)/L while Table 1 gives 0.15×10^(9)/L on 4 Mar 2024; both values are kept at their own times and no nadir fact is recorded.

The Introduction and Table 2 use lethal and fatal-trajectory wording and the Figure 2 image prints a terminal-outcome callout (pixel content, recorded in visual.json only), but no death of this patient is reported; the latest described events are palliative care with home oxygen and a stable CT on 12 March 2025, so vital status is living at presentation and nothing is inferred.

Text states complete symptom resolution by day 21 of ganciclovir, while Table 1 lists residual dyspnea (mMRC grade 2) at discharge on 8 Mar 2024 and later text reports permanent respiratory impairment; the statements are kept separately without reconciliation.

Viral PCR was not urgently performed and CMV investigation was deferred; whether or when any viral testing occurred before BAL-PCR on 18 Feb 2024 is not stated, so no not-performed observation is recorded.
Anti-MAC therapy (5 Jan 2024) and antimycobacterials (12 and 16 Jan 2024) are not stated to be the same regimen; they are kept as separate medication items.

The authors attribute lymphocyte depletion to erlotinib rechallenge and CMV pneumonitis to lymphocytopenia; the order of rechallenge before depletion is recorded, while causal and mechanistic claims in the Discussion are hypotheses and are not recorded as facts.
Methylprednisolone is listed at 1.5 mg/kg/day (05–12 Jan), reduced to 0.5 mg/kg/day by 25 Jan, and 1.0 mg/kg/day on the 18 Feb row; the course between those times is not stated.

Table 2 describes the 7 Jan 2024 erlotinib rechallenge as occurring during persistent lymphocytopenia with ALC 0.48×10^(9)/L, while the case text describes an ALC decline from 2.13 to 1.28×10^(9)/L after the rechallenge; the ALC at the time of rechallenge is not stated as one value, so no ALC observation is dated 7 Jan 2024.

Figure 2 prints further ALC and WBC data labels that the text and tables do not state, without printed date pairing; they are pixel content recorded in visual.json only and are not observations. The text values that the chart also prints (ALC 0.48, baseline 1.87, 2.13 and 1.28) agree with the image and stay text facts.
